pages.title: Crash multiplier
pages.text: Illustration only: each round has its own crash time.

pages.title: How to play
pages.text: The multiplier rises continuously from ×1 and accelerates. Cash out before the crash; the server uses the multiplier when your action arrives.$(br2)A crash loses the stake and all unclaimed winnings. The chart shows past movement and cannot predict the result.

pages.title: Event probabilities
pages.text: About 20.32% of default rounds crash instantly. Survival from the start: about 39.8% to ×2, 7.97% to ×10 and 0.159% to ×100.$(br2)Higher values are rarer. Settlement uses server ticks. Rounds are independent; there is no guaranteed safe cash-out time.

pages.title: Requirements
pages.text: Default Lv.5; initial stake cap 200,000. Wallet upgrades can raise it.$(br2)Closing, leaving or disconnecting does not pause or cash out. Surviving to ×1,000 automatically cashes out.$(br2)Payouts include the stake. Server rules may differ; check the live interface.
Craft, then right-click to use. Machines still require the matching wallet level.
